v12.v12Source: Amendment 2 measureDependence() in lib/amend2-report.mjs: syntheticTrades({seed:7, perCell:900, trueEdgeR:0, sd:1.43}) from verify-claims.mjs. Three variants per family drew entry bars from ONE shared pool of 900 bars keyed `${family}|${state}|${year}|${bar}`. effectiveCounts() (Kish over entry bars) on that synthetic set gave overlap 0.2071 / design effect 1.2316. Only the `entryBar` field was used; netR was pure Gaussian noise with ZERO injected edge and was NOT used. No strategy outcomes, no real trades.
v12.v13Change: Amendment 3 keeps the same Kish estimator but replaces the single uniform pool with relation-aware shares (NEAR_DUPLICATE 0.75, MIRROR_IMAGE 0.55, RELATED 0.30, INDEPENDENT 0.10) derived from CARD_RELATIONS. Still pure bar co-occurrence, still no outcomes.

v13.dataUsed: ONLY CARD_RELATIONS metadata (near-duplicate / mirror-image / related pairs from claim-cards.draft.mjs) plus a seeded RNG generating ENTRY-BAR co-occurrence. The simulation emits bar multiplicities only — no netR, no verdict, no strategy result, no realised trade.

comparisonToV12FourState.v12: v1.2 reportOnly.centralCaseAdjusted (4 Map states, i.i.d. -> day-clustered + v1.2 effective N)
comparisonToV12FourState.explanation: The 2-state pooling DOUBLES the raw sample in EFFICIENT (EXPANSION 375 + GRIND 531 = 906 raw), but the Amendment-3 relation-aware overlap (design effect ~2.29 vs v1.2's 1.23) removes most of that gain: near-duplicate variants do not contribute independent information. Report-only, no criterion changes.

readout.explanation: Pooling four Map states into two verdict states roughly doubles the EFFICIENT sample, but day clustering AND the larger relation-aware within-family overlap both REDUCE effective power. The control gate (excess > 0) is NOT the binding constraint because matched random baselines are negative in DEV, making the true excess larger than the +0.10R net floor. jointPowerConservative = min(net-floor power, control power).
readout.caution: This is REPORT-ONLY. It does not change CLAIM_CRITERIA, the +0.10R floor, t > 2, the verdict, or the kill criterion. If zero claims are CONFIRMED, the correct readout remains 'too little independent data', not 'textbook false'.
